description: The never-allowed list of the egress audit, shared by the API leg, the browser leg and static-hostnames. Every entry matches the name itself and every name under it (api., app., auth., data., analytics. ...). No product setting can allow a listed name: allowed_external_hosts refuses it and the capture checks fail on it whatever a product configures. static-hostnames reads ever_owned only, because analytics clients that products already ship stay in their code (switched off by default).
